Based on CSHARK's proprietary bus to test Ku-band communications.
Description

A 3U Cubesat, based on CSHARK's proprietary bus, derived from the company's PocketQube systems, will launch on a SpaceX Transporter mission in July 2025.
This is a 2-year In-Orbit Demonstration (IOD) mission to assess communication in the Ku-Band.
To demonstrate the feasibility of a Ku-band link between a small user terminal and a ground station (Gateway), paving the way for the development of a high throughput satellite constellation based on CubeSats.
